system.description:
Secret (tome). Study: a caster who can cast Animate Dead; 6 weeks, DC 15.

Teaches: a Necromancer's Undead Mastery cap rises by 5 points; any other caster controls twice the HD Animate Dead allows.

  • A 1-hour ritual on a battlefield or graveyard, for one 5th-level slot and no onyx, raises skeletons or zombies equal in number to your level, each with the HD it had in life (6 HD at most).
  • They obey you until dawn, then crumble; they count towards no cap or limit and pay no Soul Tax.
  • Recovered from the ruins of Greymorrow.
  • Its mages put husks to work from this book, and it is the reason necromancy is outlawed.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Studied in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
